title: Symmetry
question_text: Which picture correctly completes the mirror image?
explanation_script: Here is half of a picture, split by a dashed mirror line.
Find the correctly mirrored half.
Here are the five answer choices, A through E.
The correct answer is E.
Everything flips across the line -- same distance, same shape.
So the answer is E.
